title: SWF: Sound stream compilation (streaming audio)
description: Verify SoundStreamHead (tag 18) and SoundStreamBlock (tag 19) are emitted when a scene has stream-sync sounds. Read compile.ts to find existing stream sound handling. If missing, add: when a Frame has sound.syncMode === 'stream', emit SoundStreamHead before the first frame and SoundStreamBlock per frame. Tests: a doc with a stream sound compiles to SWF containing tags 18 and 19.
